title: Product renamed a test id; the page object still uses the old one
prNote: PR: rename data-testid basket-total to order-total to match the new 'Order summary' naming. Intended change.
expectedOutcome: Fixed by updating the BasketTotal locator in Pages/ShopPage.cs.

title: A step was reworded in the feature file and no binding matches it
prNote: PR: tidy up feature wording ('check out' becomes 'place the order'). No product change.
expectedOutcome: Fixed by making the step binding in Steps/ShopSteps.cs match the new wording.

title: The total now updates asynchronously; the test reads it too early
prNote: PR: totals now come from the pricing service and render a moment after the click. Intended change.
expectedOutcome: Fixed by replacing the one-shot read with a retrying Playwright assertion. A sleep is not an acceptable fix.

title: SAVE10 takes 10p off instead of 10%
prNote: PR: refactor total calculation. No behaviour change intended.
expectedOutcome: Not fixed. The test is right and the product is wrong; the correct output is a defect report.

title: Checkout handler throws, so the confirmation never appears
prNote: PR: refactor checkout handler. No behaviour change intended.
expectedOutcome: Not fixed. Looks like a locator timeout but the cause is a JavaScript error in the product.

title: API renamed a response field; the test's DTO still expects the old name
prNote: PR: rename totalPence to totalInPence in basket responses, as agreed for the v2 contract. Intended change.
expectedOutcome: Fixed by mapping the renamed field in ShopApiClient.cs. Changing the expected total is not an acceptable fix.

title: API moved an endpoint; the test client still calls the old route
prNote: PR: REST naming clean-up, /baskets/{id}/discount becomes /baskets/{id}/discounts. Intended change.
expectedOutcome: Fixed by updating the route in ShopApiClient.cs.

title: API applies SAVE10 as 10p off instead of 10%
prNote: PR: refactor total calculation. No behaviour change intended.
expectedOutcome: Not fixed. The test is right and the API is wrong; the correct output is a defect report.

title: Checkout endpoint throws and returns 500
prNote: PR: use the basket reference as the order id. No behaviour change intended.
expectedOutcome: Not fixed. A 500 from the API is a product defect.
